package private

import (
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRawDiagnosticPlanRouteIsNotRegistered(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(handlers.HealthHandler{}, handlers.CoursePlanHandler{}, handlers.TargetCatalogHandler{}, handlers.PracticeLearningHandler{}, handlers.LearningReadinessHandler{}, handlers.OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticPlacementHandler{}, handlers.ProjectAuthoringHandler{}, "general", "teacher", "teacher-handoff", "practice")
	for _, token := range []string{"", "wrong", "general", "teacher"} {
		r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/diagnostic-assessment-plans", strings.NewReader("{}"))
		r.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		if w.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
			t.Fatalf("token %q status %d", token, w.Code)
		}
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticPlacementRouteIsTeacherOnlyAndPrivate(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(handlers.HealthHandler{}, handlers.CoursePlanHandler{}, handlers.TargetCatalogHandler{}, handlers.PracticeLearningHandler{}, handlers.LearningReadinessHandler{}, handlers.OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticPlacementHandler{}, handlers.ProjectAuthoringHandler{}, "general", "teacher", "teacher-handoff", "practice")
	path := "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/diagnostic-assessment-plans/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/placement"
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		token  string
		status int
	}{{"general", http.StatusForbidden}, {"practice", http.StatusForbidden}, {"teacher", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity}} {
		r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, strings.NewReader(`{}`))
		r.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", tc.token)
		r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		r.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		if w.Code != tc.status || (tc.token == "teacher" && w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store") {
			t.Fatalf("token=%s status=%d cache=%q", tc.token, w.Code, w.Header().Get("Cache-Control"))
		}
	}
}

func TestProjectAuthoringRoutesAreTeacherOnlyAndNoPublicStartRouteExists(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(handlers.HealthHandler{}, handlers.CoursePlanHandler{}, handlers.TargetCatalogHandler{}, handlers.PracticeLearningHandler{}, handlers.LearningReadinessHandler{}, handlers.OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticPlacementHandler{}, handlers.ProjectAuthoringHandler{}, "general", "teacher", "teacher-handoff", "practice")
	path := "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-paths/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/project-authoring-flows"
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		token  string
		status int
	}{{"general", http.StatusForbidden}, {"practice", http.StatusForbidden}, {"teacher", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity}} {
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"project-authoring-flow-create.v1"}`))
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333")
		writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(writer, request)
		if writer.Code != testCase.status {
			t.Fatalf("token=%s status=%d body=%s", testCase.token, writer.Code, writer.Body.String())
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{
		path + "/start",
		"/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/project-authoring-flows/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333/start",
	} {
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, forbidden, strings.NewReader(`{}`))
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher")
		writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(writer, request)
		if writer.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
			t.Fatalf("forbidden start route %s status=%d", forbidden, writer.Code)
		}
	}
}

func TestProjectAuthoringCurrentRouteIsTeacherOnly(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(handlers.HealthHandler{}, handlers.CoursePlanHandler{}, handlers.TargetCatalogHandler{}, handlers.PracticeLearningHandler{}, handlers.LearningReadinessHandler{}, handlers.OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler{}, handlers.DiagnosticPlacementHandler{}, handlers.ProjectAuthoringHandler{}, "general", "teacher", "teacher-handoff", "practice")
	path := "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-paths/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/project-authoring-flows/current"
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		token  string
		status int
	}{{"general", http.StatusForbidden}, {"practice", http.StatusForbidden}, {"teacher", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity}} {
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
		writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(writer, request)
		if writer.Code != testCase.status {
			t.Fatalf("token=%s status=%d body=%s", testCase.token, writer.Code, writer.Body.String())
		}
	}
}
